title: Agreement with the Deterministic Run
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-augmented register program, fix an oracle and input, and let $\beta$ be a Boolean value. For any register-machine configuration $a$, memory tape and head position $\mu$, and time $T$, if the deterministic run obtained by retaining the deterministic instructions of $A$ (and replacing its memory instructions by the answer $\beta$) is still running at time $T$, then at every time $t\le T$ the run of $A$ from $(a,\mu)$ agrees with that deterministic run and retains the same memory tape and head position $\mu$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle and input are fixed
$\mu$ is a memory tape and head position
The deterministic run at time $T$ has a nonhalting state
